config.scope: Exploratory replay of an already inspected single-study dataset. Policies access only revealed labels. No new enzymes, blind external validation, calibrated uncertainty or industrial performance claim.

extension.anchor_rule: Every sequence group with at least 16 measured proteins and at least 48 measured proteins outside it; 50 starts per eligible group; equal weight per anchor group.
extension.threshold_rule: Full original task 90th percentile, evaluator only, ties included. Same threshold in both scenarios.
extension.ablation_rule: Prediction-only; mean plus beta=1 bootstrap standard deviation; mean-rank plus weight=0.25 diversity-rank; existing combined rule. No parameter search.
extension.diagnostic_rule: At the first shared decision only: correlation of bootstrap spread with absolute log1p error across all untested candidates; and error by uncertainty quartile. Diagnostic outcomes never enter a policy.
extension.scope: Exploratory robustness and ablation extension after inspecting the original campaign results. Sequence groups are 60% identity connected components, not validated biological families. After the first acquired batch, new-group labels may train subsequent batches. Not permanent group holdout or external validation.

data_manifest.grouping_scope: Connected components computed on the union of all three tasks, without assay labels.
data_manifest.missingness: Only observed assays used per task. Tasks have different populations; no zero imputation.
data_manifest.scope: Retrospective single-study benchmark on natural enzyme constructs, not mutation-effect prediction or industrial validation. Warm neutral condition was explored in PET Scout before this extension; this is not a pristine prospective test.

embedding_metadata.label: ESM-2 35M
embedding_metadata.timing_note: One measured run, not a hardware benchmark. Loading includes downloads/cache reads. Peak RSS covers the whole process. Models run in separate CLI processes.
embedding_metadata.pretraining_note: Unknown overlap with pretraining sequences; no assay labels used in frozen embeddings.
